_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Gives one page its own copy of a shared section so other pages keep the shared one; staged as a draft, dry run by default.

description: Give one page its own copy of a shared section; every other page keeps the shared one. A draft — publish_site to go live. A section the layout places is hidden on that page instead (share_section name + hide).

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

dryRun.description: Default true: report what would change and write nothing. false: stage the change as a draft (publish_site makes it live).

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

ifMatch.description: The page's content hash. If the page changed since, nothing is written.

name.description: Section name. Its file is fragments/<name>.html, placed with <dotsy-fragment name="<name>">.

pageKey.description: Content key of the page that gets its own copy, e.g. 'pricing.html'.

name: detach_section
